title: Flow table sorted column header light background and missing chevron in dark mode
answers: Why is the sort chevron invisible on the flow table in dark mode?
Why does the sorted column header keep a white background in dark theme?
How to theme the flow table sorted column header across light and dark modes?
body:
Symptom: In dark mode, the flow table sorted column header stays near-white and the sort chevron icon is invisible.
Root cause: web/src/css/flowtable.less:&.sort-asc, &.sort-desc used hardcoded color literals compiled via LESS lighten() and fadeout() because LESS functions cannot operate on CSS var() tokens.
Fix pattern: Define a themeable CSS custom property under :root and [data-theme="dark"] in web/src/css/global.less, and derive alpha transparency in consuming stylesheets using CSS color-mix() instead of LESS fadeout().
Constraints: Applies when styling mitmweb components that require theme-sensitive colors with alpha blending; does not apply to unthemed static styles or non-browser contexts.
applies: web/src/css/ flow table styling and theming in mitmweb
